answers.core: This is about improving the Android editor UX and making Godot integrate better with the system.
answers.workaround: Users can create the `.nomedia` file themselves, but Android does not provide any built-in way to do that, so they must use a third-party app instead. These apps often don't provide a great user experience due to containing ads or requiring users to jump through hoops to achieve what ought to be an easy task.

title: Prevent project images/video/audio from showing up in the media library by writing `.nomedia` in the Android editor
